tiers.name: Baseline
tiers.rule: Price more than 5% above the 200-day average

tiers.name: Lean In
tiers.rule: 5–10% below the 200-day average, or a 10–20% drawdown from the high

tiers.name: Aggressive
tiers.rule: More than 10% below the 200-day average, or a drawdown of more than 20%

framework.combine_rule: When the signals disagree, the more aggressive tier applies.
framework.dip_rule: If the latest session closed down 1.5% or more, a buy-the-dip flag is shown on top of the tier.

latest.explanation: QQQ closed 6.6% below its 200-day average, which puts it in the Lean In zone (2× contribution). The latest session fell 2.0%, which also flags a buy-the-dip day.
